label: Causation, persistence and identity
text: PL.O.A1.3 Causation, persistence and identity. Causation answers: regularity, counterfactual dependence, process, interventionist (Woodward 2003). Persistence answers: endurance, perdurance (Lewis 1986).

warrant.standard: Fits paradigm cases; survives trouble cases
warrant.defeaters: Pre-emption and overdetermination; statue and clay; Frankfurt cases; relativity against presentism
